reviews.fs-the-radon-nikodym-theorem-holds-witho: Reviewed the full counterexample after the dependency repair. Counting-null sets are only empty, so Lebesgue measure is absolutely continuous with respect to counting measure. A density would vanish at every singleton but then integrate to zero on the whole interval, contradicting its Lebesgue mass one. The added uncountability fact also proves that counting measure on the interval is not sigma-finite, since its finite-measure sets are finite.
